caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic bowl positioned in the center of the composition against a plain, light beige background. The bowl is round with an irregular shape and has a wide, open mouth. The inside and rim of the bowl are a dark, almost black color with a slightly shiny, glazed appearance, while the outer surface is a warm brownish-yellow tone with some visible patches of lighter color, particularly one white spot near the bottom edge. The rim of the bowl is uneven and has several chips or worn areas displaying a lighter color underneath. There are subtle shadow effects beneath and inside the bowl, suggesting depth and a three-dimensional form. There are also small handwritten notations beneath the drawing, including the words “Scale 3/4"=1" Irregular Bowl” and a signature reading “Clyde L. Chaney.”
title: Glazed Clay Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
